- raw-telemetry-sample-20270624.csv (anonymized daily sample with columns you requested)

Key points up front:
- We run a hybrid sampling model: passive production sampling (default) + configurable synthetic heartbeats. Production sampling uses deterministic reservoir sampling per-minute per-region to limit noise while preserving distributional properties. Synthetic probes run every 30s by default and are tagged separately.
- Multi-region windows are weighted by request volume per-region for the measurement window (we include formula in the playbook). We can provide region-specific percentiles on request.
- Partial-region degradation: credits are triggered when an availability delta > 1.5% persists for the SLA window and affects >= 20% of the weighted traffic to your account; credits prorated by affected weight. Example scenarios in section 4 of the playbook.

Sara — quick technical clarifications from the measurement side (copying Lauren for procurement nuance):

On sampling and dedup:
- Production sampling: we use deterministic reservoir sampling keyed by request hash with a per-region fixed seed so samples are stable across windows. This avoids repeated amplification from bursty clients. Dedup rule: identical request_id within 5s is treated as duplicate and collapsed.
- Synthetic vs production: synthetic probes are labeled probe_type=synthetic; they are only used for availability signal, not for latency percentiles unless explicitly enabled in config. You can opt-in to include synthetic in p95 for specific endpoints; default is exclude.

On region weighting and windowing:
- Rolling-window (60-minute) evaluation for incident detection; daily rolling aggregation for SLA calculation. Regional weighting uses request_volume(region)/sum(request_volume) over the SLA window. We can publish the daily per-region weight CSV as part of the export.

On evidence export & retention:
- Daily CSV export includes timestamp (ISO8601), region, probe_type, request_id (hashed), observed_latency_ms, status_code, deployment_id. Sample attached (raw-telemetry-sample-20270624.csv) is anonymized and representative.
- Retention: telemetry stored 90 days by default; extended retention can be configured under Dedicated/Private plans.

On crediting for partial-region issues:
- If a region shows availability below the agreed threshold for >= 3 consecutive SLA windows and that region contributes >= 20% weighted traffic, a credit event is calculated as: (agreed_availability - observed_availability) * affected_weight * monthly_commit_value / 100. We include examples in the playbook.

If that matches your needs, Sean and I can prepare a short addendum (DocuSign) that captures the export format and retention for your procurement team.
